title: Column resize telemetry and visual feedback system for virtualized tables
creator: Avery Park
description:
Goal: define a lightweight, privacy-safe telemetry shape and a cohesive visual feedback system for column resizing in the virtualized Table component. Scope includes mouse/trackpad/keyboard/touch interactions, snapline behaviour, compressed/compact density modes, and accessible announcements. Excludes server-side metrics or quota billing (handled by infra).

Why: We see ambiguous resize behaviour across breakpoints and density modes. Engineers report difficulty tuning snapping heuristics without client-side interaction data. Designers need a predictable visual grammar for resize affordances that works with virtualization (cells unmounting) and respects reduced-motion. This ticket pairs design decisions with instrumentation guidance so ENG can implement and iterate with real usage data.
acceptance_criteria: Documented telemetry schema that includes start/commit/cancel events and contextual fields (device, density, snap_applied, duration_ms, delta_px, pre_width_px, post_width_px, interaction_origin)
Design spec for visual feedback: hover handle states, drag ghost, snapline animation (prefers-reduced-motion compliant), keyboard focus halo and inline width preview
Accessible text strategy: aria-live announcements for keyboard commits and clear instructions for screen reader users
Fallback behavior defined for virtualized rows (preview pinned to header when body unmounts)
Prototype Figma frames and an interactive HTML prototype demonstrating mouse, touch, and keyboard flows
Engineering sign-off on telemetry schema and a short implementation checklist (events + opt-out flag)
Unit visual tests and a small perf budget: resize visuals should render within 8ms on target devices under normal conditions
comments: 2026-03-01 Avery Park: Kickoff - paired with ENG to identify telemetry gaps. Initial list of metrics proposed. Planning to keep payload small to avoid noise and privacy surface area.
2026-03-03 Jordan Nguyen: Draft Figma frames uploaded: handle states, snapline, compact density preview. Note: compact mode reduces handle hitbox; proposing persistent corner handle for touch.
2026-03-04 Maya Singh (Engineering): Telemetry draft looks good. Request: include a session-level sample_rate and an opt_out flag. Also added ENG-64210 dependency for telemetry transport work.
2026-03-05 Design review: PM and Accessibility reviewed visuals. Feedback: use a single-color high-contrast snapline and ensure aria-live message only on commit (not continuous).
2026-03-07 Jordan Nguyen: Updated spec to prefer CSS transforms for the ghost preview to keep main thread work low. Added reduced-motion variants (no translate animation, show static snapline).

2026-03-08 UX Validation: Quick hallway test with three engineers. Findings: keyboard width preview needs clearer units (px vs %). Decision: show px by default and % as hover tooltip for column groups.

2026-03-09 Engineering review: ENG asked for a unique event id per interaction to correlate with console traces. Added 'interaction_id' to telemetry schema. Also flagged potential privacy review — security_review_required set to false but ENG will confirm with Security if session sampling exceeds threshold.

2026-03-10 Jordan Nguyen: Preparing PR description and checklist. Next steps: ship prototype, get ENG to instrument events behind a feature flag, run 2 weeks of sampling, and iterate on snap thresholds based on distribution.
